definition: Estimates Civic Tech Marketplaces readiness from component maturity.

Honest scoring is the point: a marketplace hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

description:

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where govtech catalogs monitoring, marketplace logistics redundancy, or procurement reform maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Civic Tech Marketplaces Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Civic Tech Marketplaces: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Civic Tech Marketplaces — marketplaces for civic technology.

Phase 1 — Prove (govtech catalogs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (marketplace logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (procurement reform): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (pilot funding): marketplace hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and governments-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
